title: Making Sense of Demonyms - Nationality Nouns (2/2)
titleZh: 搞懂國民稱謂──表示國籍的名詞（2/2）
summaryZh: 繼續介紹各種國民稱謂字尾的來源，並提供查證資料的網站。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Everyday Grammar

sentences.text: Demonyms are usually found in their plural form, referring to a group of people.
sentences.zh: 國民稱謂通常以複數形式出現，用來指一群人。

sentences.text: To make some demonyms singular, you can add the suffix man or woman, as in Frenchman, Scotswoman, Irishwoman, and Dutchman.
sentences.zh: 有些國民稱謂要變單數，可以加上 -man 或 -woman，像是 Frenchman、Scotswoman、Irishwoman 和 Dutchman。

sentences.text: Contact with the German language also added the suffix er, as in Netherlanders and Luxemburgers.
sentences.zh: 和德文接觸之後，英文又多了 -er 這個字尾，例如 Netherlanders 和 Luxemburgers。

sentences.text: And people from Kosovo are called Kosovars, with a little help from the language of Albania.
sentences.zh: 而科索沃人叫做 Kosovars，這要歸功於阿爾巴尼亞語的影響。

sentences.text: We hear the influence of Arabic with the e- suffix in the demonyms for many countries in the Middle East, Central Asia, and Africa.
sentences.zh: 在中東、中亞和非洲許多國家的國民稱謂裡，我們從 e- 這個字尾聽得出阿拉伯文的影響。

sentences.text: They include Pakistanis, Uzbekistanis, Tajikistanis, Yemenis, and Somalis.
The most common way to form a noun from a country name is to add ands, as in Germans, Americans, and Moroccans.
sentences.zh: 從國名造出名詞最常見的方式，就是加上 -ans，例如 Germans、Americans 和 Moroccans。

sentences.text: This is a form English got from Latin and French.
sentences.zh: 這種形式是英文從拉丁文和法文借來的。

sentences.text: We got the e- suffix from French by way of the Portuguese, who introduced the British to the Chinese and Japanese.
sentences.zh: e- 這個字尾則是經由葡萄牙人從法文傳過來的，當年就是葡萄牙人把英國人介紹給中國人和日本人。

sentences.text: They share the suffix with the Marshallese, Benanese, and Bhutanese.
sentences.zh: Marshallese、Benanese 和 Bhutanese 也共用這個字尾。

sentences.text: To find the official name of a country or its people, you can go to the World Factbook.
sentences.zh: 想查某個國家或其人民的正式名稱，可以上《世界概況》網站。

sentences.text: The website also has useful maps and information on each country.
sentences.zh: 這個網站還有各國實用的地圖和資料。
以上就是本集的《日常文法》。
